name: Ripio wBRL
oneLiner: WBRL is Ripio's wrapped Brazilian real stablecoin targeting 1 WBRL = 1 BRL, backed by BRL cash and local-currency instruments under Ripio's wFIAT issuance.
collateral: Brazilian-real cash and liquid local-currency instruments backing Ripio wBRL at a one Brazilian real target
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed local-currency stablecoin route targeting 1 WBRL = 1 BRL through Ripio's wFIAT issuance, redemption, and on/off-ramp infrastructure

mintAuthority.summary: WBRL is an issuer-managed Ripio wFIAT token. Ethereum role logs resolve Ripio's shared admin as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE plus two current MINTER_ROLE holders; non-Ethereum deployments remain unverified.

controls.label: Ripio shared WBRL admin and MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Ethereum role logs resolve this account as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and a current MINTER_ROLE holder. Signer custody was not decoded as EOA, backend, Safe, or contract.

controls.label: WBRL secondary Ethereum MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Ethereum role logs resolve this account as a current MINTER_ROLE holder. The account/source identity was not decoded in the lane review.

review.evidence: Review is scoped to Ethereum role-holder coverage: Ripio identifies WBRL as a wrapped local stablecoin, and the lane-2 role reconstruction resolves current Ethereum DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE holders.
unresolvedQuestions: Base, World Chain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis role holders and admins are not yet reconstructed.
Ethereum implementation source for 0xfbab5d...7f9d remains unresolved.
Custody/type of 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b and any per-chain equivalent admin is unresolved.
Secondary MINTER_ROLE holder identity/source for 0x46167cB034feC6ceC46CaeD4f61281f5Aa0Eb0e6 is unresolved.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Ripio wBRL is centrally issued across multiple EVM chains; the public source confirms issuer-managed wFIAT mechanics but does not prove a holder-level blacklist path.

reserves.name: Brazilian-real cash and local-currency liquid instruments

notices.title: No per-token attestation located
notices.message: Ripio describes wFIAT local-currency backing, but no reliable public per-token reserve attestation was found for WBRL during this addition. Curated reserves remain conservative until source coverage improves.
